whoItsFor: Individual developers and power users who want a personal AI assistant that runs agents in isolated containers, reachable through messaging apps, and that they can read and modify themselves. Teams wanting a hosted product with no code changes are not the target.
useCases: Send a daily briefing or sales-pipeline overview to a messaging app on a schedule
Review git history weekly and update a README when it drifts
Compile news from Hacker News and TechCrunch into a Monday morning briefing

requirements.runtime: Node.js 22+, pnpm 10+, Docker (Docker Desktop on macOS/Windows, Docker Engine on Linux)
